context: Tests whether the agent flips alwaysApply in BOTH the rule file frontmatter AND the tile.json steering entry when converting a universal rule to a conditional one. The tile prescribes that the two surfaces stay in agreement — flipping only one leaves the rule loaded universally in some consumer agents and scoped in others. Baseline agents typically flip only the rule file frontmatter (because that is where they read the rule) and forget about the tile.json side, OR flip only the tile.json side (because the question mentions converting the entry). The tile teaches that both must move together, with applyTo added to the rule file to declare the new scope.

checklist.name: Rule file frontmatter flipped to alwaysApply: false
checklist.description: The rules/pr-template-checklist.md frontmatter's alwaysApply value is changed from true to false. Scores zero if the value remains true, or if the field is removed entirely

checklist.name: Rule file frontmatter gains applyTo with glob patterns
checklist.description: The rules/pr-template-checklist.md frontmatter contains a new applyTo field (or accepted alias: globs, paths) whose value includes glob patterns matching PR-related artifacts. The patterns must include at least one match for `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE` (with or without the `.md` extension, with or without the directory variant). Scores zero if the field is missing or contains no glob patterns at all; partial credit (10) if globs are present but do not match PR templates specifically

checklist.name: applyTo value combines globs with a natural-language clause
checklist.description: The applyTo value includes both a glob list and a natural-language clause separated by an em dash (— or --), e.g., '.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE*, CONTRIBUTING.md — when authoring or editing PR artifacts'. The clause expresses the action-level scope in prose. Scores zero if the value is glob-only or prose-only

checklist.name: tile.json steering entry flipped to alwaysApply: false
checklist.description: The updated tile.json's pr-template-checklist steering entry's alwaysApply value is changed from true to false. Scores zero if the value remains true, or if the entry is dropped entirely

checklist.name: Both alwaysApply values flipped together (no orphaned surface)
checklist.description: Both the rule file frontmatter and the tile.json steering entry have alwaysApply: false. This is the lockstep agreement the tile prescribes. Scores zero if only one surface was flipped, leaving them inconsistent (the most common baseline failure on this scenario)

checklist.name: Rule body content is preserved unchanged
checklist.description: The body of rules/pr-template-checklist.md (everything after the frontmatter block) is byte-identical to the input. The scenario is a frontmatter-only edit; modifying the body bullets is out of scope and counts against the agent

checklist.name: Existing rule (commit-conventions) is preserved unchanged
checklist.description: The commit-conventions steering entry in tile.json remains with its original path and alwaysApply: true value. Scores zero if it is dropped, renamed, or has its alwaysApply flipped
